name: pr_explorer
description: PR Explorer's analysis half: a pr-explorer agent that diffs a local branch range or a GitHub pull request (fetched by commit into a local clone) with git, splits the patch per file with the pr_diff_split plugin, groups the files into logical units, and records them in the pr_explorer surface the PR Explorer page reads.

inference_slots.name: analyzer
inference_slots.description: Groups a branch range's changed files into logical units and summarizes each. Any capable profile.

plugins.name: pr_diff_split
plugins.description: Splits a git diff patch in <root>/.pr-explorer/patches into one PrExplorerDiff document per changed file (bounded per file, paged per call), returns the file list without diff text, and deletes the patch on a final remove_patch call.

bind_dir.description: The <root>/.pr-explorer/patches folder holding the patch file (written only by remove_patch)

dir.description: Absolute path of <root>/.pr-explorer/patches. Read-only unless remove_patch is set; the plugin refuses any other folder.

patch.description: The patch file's name in dir, e.g. <analysis_id>.patch. A name, never a path.

analysis_id.description: The analysis every written file document belongs to.

offset.description: First file (0-based, patch order) to write; pass the previous call's next_offset.

max_file_bytes.description: Bound on each file's stored diff. Defaults to 262144.

remove_patch.description: Delete the patch file and do nothing else. Call once, after every page is stored. Needs write access to dir.
